scope: All 50 unchanged development IDs in existing split run order; no reserved-game packets, inference or analysis.

execution.stopping: Inspect only top-level provider errors, never model evidence text. Stop new paid requests on first access denial; preserve exact HTTP status. Keyboard interruption seals partial results; uncertain claims never resend. Existing terminal records are reused, not retried.

comparisons.eligibility: Within each comparison use the exact intersection of all listed probabilities, verified finalized labels and unchanged preferred market quotes. Retain all 50 rows and every exclusion. Never compare differently scoped aggregates without n and IDs.

metrics.secondary: Natural-log loss with existing epsilon=1e-15 clipping only for log loss
metrics.calibration: Existing ten equal-width buckets with counts, mean predicted probability and observed frequency
metrics.extreme_probability: p<=0.10 or p>=0.90, inclusive; descriptive only
metrics.classification: Home prediction iff p>=0.50 (tie goes home); accuracy is secondary
metrics.confidence: Mean abs(p-0.5), mean max(p,1-p), and mean predicted home-win probability; no alpha fitting
metrics.market: Existing preferred valid two-sided YES midpoint, candle ending <=cutoff and lag<=1200 seconds; quote refresh age unknown. No quote/trade substitution.

bootstrap.procedure: Within each named intersection resample game-row indices with replacement, jointly across methods; shared indices for all comparisons within that intersection. Percentile 2.5/97.5 with existing linear (B-1)*q quantile interpolation. Empty intersections yield null intervals.
bootstrap.interpretation: Descriptive development-informed historical intervals; possible outcome memory and dependent games; no significance-based winner selection.

diagnostics.directionality: Reuse strength_diagnostic: weaker requires strictly lower completed-season win fraction AND average differential. Compare v1/v2 on common statistically assessable games with successful A observations, even when another group prevents a full forecast. List missing/tied/discordant statistics and inference exclusions separately. No corrections.
diagnostics.groups: For each group: planned/source-usable/success/skip/insufficient/failure/unattempted counts; successful home/away/neutral and strength/sufficiency counts, mapped-LR and abs-log-LR distributions. Separate all valid returned assessments from usable estimates so insufficient neutral placeholders are never counted as usable neutral.
diagnostics.injuries: Preserve both team submission states and source qualifiers for all games. Report one-sided missing/unsubmitted cases, adequacy/limited labels, directions and magnitudes. Source-usable vs source-missing strata and offline injury removal scores retain explicit n/IDs.
diagnostics.dependence: Assess A/B sign agreement only where both group observations succeed, excluding zero contributions from nonzero reinforcement. Report method-specific and common game IDs, all contribution distributions (source zeros separate from failures), and removal scores on each comparison intersection. Venue splits can reconstruct season totals and duplicate strength information; no causal claim.
diagnostics.leave_one_out: Reuse frozen aggregation/omission probabilities for raw and conservative v1/v2 on each exact comparison intersection, without additional model calls. Full-minus/omission-minus score changes are descriptive, never used to remove groups.
diagnostics.shrinkage: Compare fixed alpha1 and alpha0.5 on identical games: proper scores, calibration, mean distance from0.5/confidence and mean home probability. Report changes toward0.5 without equating them with calibrated improvement.

reproducibility: Commit this plan and tested execution/diagnostic implementation before paid inference. Save immutable preflight request identities and source hashes, preserve original records, publish sanitized observations/hashes/accounting, private-cache verify and public offline replay. No protocol, prompt, mapping, split, data or prior-record changes.
